name: Barbell Pause Deadlift
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, hinge with a flat back, and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core, pull slack out of the bar, and push through the floor to lift the bar just below your knees.
Hold the bar completely motionless off the floor while keeping your lats tight and weight balanced over your midfoot.
Drive your hips forward to lock out tall at the top, then hinge smoothly to return the bar to the floor.
tips: Keep the bar tight against your shins during the pause so your hips do not drift backward.
Maintain a flat spine throughout the hold and avoid letting your shoulders round forward.
